nom: FARMACY Bright On Daily AHA Foam Exfoliator

avis.texte: I love this exfoliator! I use it whenever my face needs a refresh and it does brighten my skin!
It left my skin feeling silky smooth and and I really loved the sent.

I use this as an exfoliatior when my face is feeling dull and needs that extra boost. I do genuinely feel like my face looks brighter and refreshed after. I have dry skin that really benefits from this! Love!
I've been using this for a couple of weeks and already see brighter, smoother skin. The formula feels great, the scent is light, and the mousse pump makes it super easy to use.

avis.titre: Not for me but wish it was!
avis.texte: I've used this product in the shower once a week over the last few weeks. While I was really optimistic, my skin can't handle it :-( it dries out my skin and I find that I need to moisturize even more than usual to keep the redness down. I started out using it every other day then moved to once a week to try to see if I could make it work. Sadly couldn't but it does smell so good!!!
This exfoliating foam makes my skin bright and glowy. It is gentle and kind to skin, even with AHAs. I love Farmacy's products and think the packaging is cute

I am a 40 year old woman that has recently developed uneven skin tone and texture, which has not been a good time. I've tried a few different products that have been highly recommended and I've been less than impressed. But this stuff is great! It's gentle enough to use on my skin, which tends to dry up with exfoliating products. It took a little time for me to begin seeing improvement, which is why I'm only giving 4 stars. I'll be buying another bottle though, which says a lot for someone like me. I just need a bit more time to be completely satisfied with the results.

This product is light and refreshing! There is a mild scent but it does not affect my sensitive skin. My skin feels softer and my glowy after use and it is helping clear up some of my blemishes. I am very happy with this product!

If you hate harsh scrubs but want that smooth "filter" look, you need to try Farmacy's Bright On Foam. 🫧 It's a 30-second wash-off AHA treatment that actually keeps your moisture barrier happy thanks to the Panthenol. No stinging, just instant brightness. 10/10. 🍋✨
This product was great. It was a refreshing clean and left my skin looking visibly brighter. I did see a difference on my dark spots.

I've really been enjoying the Bright On Daily Foam Exfoliator from Farmacy. I did receive it for free for an honest review. The foam feels super light and silky smooth on my skin. It leaves my face feeling fresh and actually clean. After using it consistently, my skin looked a little brighter and more even. It's easy to work into my routine and doesn't feel harsh or drying at all. The only downside for me was the pump… only in the shower, it didn't always work well after the first pump. That was a bit annoying, but the formula itself is so nice that I'll be repurchasing. Overall, I recommend.

Cleansing is such an important part of skin care, and I have fallen in love with how nice exfoliating makes my skin feel. This cleanser lathers so nicely and leaves my skin feeling so clean and bright.
I love that this is not harsh on the skin it's perfect for sensitive skin and the foam is such a good gentle exfoliation. I noticed a change in my skin after the first use.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again and again
avis.texte: I use this product to make my face feel amazing again. After I take off my makeup from work this is always next.
I use this everyday after showering. It has become a new step in my daily routine that just makes my face feel so much cleaner. It is very light and did not cause any irritation.

I was really scared to try this product as I thought it would burn or irritate my skin. But it is gentle and even after just a couple uses I am really seeing an improvement in my skin's texture and appearance. The winter month's are especially harsh on my skin and I always feel like it is extra dull. But this exfoliator has made such a difference. I love the color/design of the bottle and that the ingredients are clean - something I can confidently use. I will definitely be purchasing more and already am telling my friends to get it too!
I like when products have instructions on how much and often to use. Leaves my skin feeling super soft. I do have to make sure to moisturize right after.
It took a little to get used to the foaming but love the cleanser and makes me feel refreshed in the AM

I deal with a lot of texture on my face and this has really helped but feels much more gentle than a scrub. I love it! It doesn't have a strong smell and is very easy and mess free to use. I noticed a difference in my skins texture within a few weeks. I'm sold on this product!

I have tried so make exfoliators. I normally have issues with them cause my face to get sore. This did not do that. My face did not get red. It did not have a bad smell. My face feels extremely clean once I've washed it. I am absolutely so happy I found this product.

avis.titre: An amazing addition to my skincare routine
avis.texte: I've been really enjoying the Farmacy Bright On AHA Foam Exfoliator. The texture is light and it feels gentle on my face, but it does a great job smoothing and brightening my skin. It helps my skin glow without feeling overly dry or stripped at all. I like that it uses AHAs plus ingredients like lemon peel to help with dullness, and my skin looks more even and clear after using it consistently. I've also noticed that my makeup application is smoother and easier. Since it's a chemical exfoliant, make sure to follow up with SPF during the day. Overall, it's an easy, glow-boosting step that fits nicely into my routine. I received this product complimentary for review, but will definitely be purchasing when I run out!

I loved using this on my face. My biggest concern was my nose area,which gets clogged easily with dirt. However, this product would leave my nose feeling smooth and clean. I used this product every other day but the smoothness would last the next day.

I received Farmacy Bright On Daily Foam Exfoliator for free in exchange for my honest review. So far, I'm really liking it. The foaming texture of it was nice, application felt good. It is smoothing the texture of my skin gradually without being too harsh and causing irritation like some exfoliants. And, a nice bonus, it has a nice citrus scent. Overall, I'm pretty impressed!

After using this product it's so brighting to the face and leaves it so smooth and love that it's also a foam so easy to apply it. It has a subtle citrus smell not overpowering at all did my combo skin wonders no stripping of skin best glow given

Okay this is AMAZING! I love how light feeling it is! It makes my face feel SO soft. It did give me a few bumps the first few days but my face is very sensitive but it went away and my face brightened up in like 2 weeks! It has cut the redness down which is great for me. I use it at night. I've only used la roche posay vit c and this is better. I will definitely buy this when I run out. Thank you so much bzzagent.

This cleanser is amazing! The foam is very light and gentle, and a little goes a long way. My face feels really smooth after using this. I notice an improvement in my skin texture. Compared to other AHA products, this does not dry out my skin at all. This is a great everyday gentle product for glowy and clean skin! I received this product in exchange for my honest review.

First time using Farmacy Bright On and I'm impressed. The texture is gentle but effective, giving a light exfoliation without irritation. My skin felt instantly smoother and looked brighter after rinsing. It didn't strip or dry me out, just left a fresh, clean glow. A great daily exfoliating cleanse. Perfect for mornings when I want polish without harshness or tightness. Love it.!
Love this foam it is great but can be a little messy! It brightened my face and smelled great!

I really like this lightweight foam cleanser. It's soft and gentle but it's still cleanses without stripping your skin and making a feel tight afterwards. Your skin looks instantly brighter and smoother. The scent is fresh and airy. You don't even need to use a whole entire pump to cleanse your entire face. Foam texture is very velvety.
I like how this feels and smells, but it's hard to say if it's actually doing anything honestly. And the full retail price is a bit much for something that washes off your face but that's just me.

I think my favorite part is the scent. That citrus scent every morning i almost have come to look forward to and i have only been using it for a week. I have high hopes for this product as i have heard good things. I'm hoping it helps my dark spots fade over time

avis.titre: This product is the beez neez!
avis.texte: I loved how gentle the foam was on my face and my face was so silky after every use. Even the pump applicator was easy use! Would definitely recommend it to others with sensitive and non-sensitive skin :)

Thanks to Farmacy for sending me a free sample of their Bright On Daily AHA Foam Exfoliator through the BzzAgent sampling program, I am feeling so glowing and happy. I am genuinely obsessed with how this foam transforms from a cloud-like texture into a source of power treatment that gently leaves my skin looking radiant in a few seconds. Unlike other chemical exfoliants that can feel harsh or sticky on my skin, this formula is incredibly gentle and refreshing, making it the perfect evening pick-me-up for a smooth finish. With just a small amount of foam like in my photo, it helps me get rid of the dirt and prepares me well for the evening moisture layers. I'm so excited to have found a daily exfoliator that actually delivers an instant, healthy-looking sparkle without any irritation. This product's a total skincare win and I already bought a new bottle after finishing the sample.

I've been really impressed with the Bright On Daily AHA Foam Exfoliator. The foam texture is light and gentle, but it still feels effective. It exfoliates without any harsh scrubbing or irritation, which is rare for a daily exfoliant. My skin feels noticeably smoother and brighter after using it, and I love that it doesn't leave my face feeling tight or stripped. It rinses clean, layers well with the rest of my routine, and works beautifully even on sensitive or reactive skin. This has become an easy, low-effort way to keep my skin clear and glowing without overdoing exfoliation. A great option if you want results without compromising your skin barrier.

I really like this one and how well it works. Its ingredients such as multi citrus peels and mandelic acid come together nicely and leave my skin looking hydrated, smooth, and bright with a beautiful appearance. Only after a week of use, it has minimized the small bumps around my chin. I did at the start have to use it every other day since it took a little for my sensitive skin to get used to but after the few first days I was able to use it as normal. It's a good exfoliator for smooth and clear skin. Farmacy Bright On Daily Foam Exfoliator

I went to ulta with extremely dry skin under my elf glow tint and I was embarrassed that others has to look at me. I do not exfoliate bc it does nothing for me. I read the online reviews and the all reviews; I chose this. Wow! I put on my Verse moisturizer after it; perfect. I got no sting from this exfoliation. My skin was smooth and even the next day; and I didnt use moisturizer and it was SMOOOoooTh!! Ulta app needs an autocorrect fixer.

Although it was given to me as a test try, I still enjoyed the product! I use it 2 times a day, in the morning, and at night. The only complaint i have is the stickiness, it makes my face feel like i need to hurry and scrub, but i started using less, and it did not feel it any longer. I would definitely recommend this for people who are looking for that clean refreshed feeling throughout the day, especially if you wear make up! *I was given this product in exchange for a Review, though it doesn't have any effect on how I feel about the product!

I am in love with the product. After I use it, my skin feels so smooth and baby soft. It also feels super clean and does not have an unpleasant smell like some exfoliators do. I will repurchase when I run out of it. Another hit from Farmacy!

avis.titre: Will try again in a few weeks
avis.texte: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I really want to like this product but when I use it my face feels tight. I am not sure if it it is relating to the weather because there has been a winter storm and extreme cold or if it is just my skin doesn't like it. Everyone else seems to love it and I am hoping once I try it again it will work as it has for everyone else

After using this for the last couple of weeks I have been loving it. It's gentle yet cleansing. It has a light citrusy scent and is not strong. It foams up nicely and cleanses my skin great with out disturbing my skin barrier. I have noticed it's does brighten my skin.
I just came back from a trip and my skin was feeling very rough. The exfoliator was really gentle and made my skin feel much smoother after just one use.

This product was very easy and fun to use. I have used this for the last two weeks in the cold, and my skin has remained breakout-free and feels soft. The foam was very lightweight with a very slight citrus scent that did not linger or irritate the eyes. It washes off easily and does not leave product behind. It does not leave the skin feeling stripped or dehydrated. I would recommend this product to anyone who is looking for an exfoliant that leaves the skin feeling fresh without any product residue remaining after use.

Obsessed with this exfoliator! It uses micro ingredients to gently exfoliate the skin without being irritating. It leaves my skin refreshed and so soft. It does not dry my skin out either. i love the subtle citrus scent it has to it. Perfect for everyday use and gentle on my skin. 10/10
Love this stuff! It's very lightweight but foams up nicely. It leaves my skin soft, smooth and hydrated and I've noticed my skin is looking more radiant too!!

I LOVE Farmacy, it's my entire skin care routine. I've been using this consistently since getting it and my skin does look and feel super good. My only complaint is that it feels a little bit more like it's cleansing than exfoliating. Either way I'd probably get it again!

avis.titre: Earned it's permanent place in my facial routine!
avis.texte: Such a quick and easy product! The fresh orange scent is refreshing but subtle. It doesn't overpower other product scents. It's gentle on my sensitive skin with better effects than a physical exfoliant. It makes my skin more even and I don't need as much/any makeup most days. As a stand alone it is a quick process that leaves your skin smooth and clean. BUT using it before other steps in a routine boosts the effectiveness of the other products. Example: using it before a collagen face mask gives better results than standard face mask use.

It cleanses and brightens the skin, leaving you with a feeling of deep cleansing and freshness in the morning. The lather is very smooth and doesn't leave the skin feeling dry or irritated. However, I wasn't entirely satisfied with the scent.

I've been using it a few times a week for several weeks. My skin is softer, more hydrated and brighter. It feels great on the skin. I use it after a nightly shower followed my a nighttime moisturizer. However, I also have had small breakouts which I haven't had in years. I will continue to use to see if the breakouts continue

I think this is a really nice cleanser. I like how it is a foam consistency which feels. light and gentle on the skin and how it has micro-exfoliants to help exfoliate your skin. I think it is a great size for a cleanser too but I wish it was a bit stronger for exfoliation. I think this product is perfect for someone with dry sensitive skin but as someone with oily acne prone skin I'm looking for something that goes a little deeper. Thank you Farmacy for providing this product for free in exchange for a review.

This product is an amazing gentle exfoliate. It foams great and you feel the difference in your skin right after use. Truly recommend to anyone looking for an exfoliant that is gentle but you can see the difference.
After using this product my face has felt so soft and my spots are clearing up
this item is amazing. Ive been using it for years now and all I can say is that it is spectacular and I always recommend it. It leaves my skin super clear and it looks amazing!

I've been using this before bed every night, and I love the way it feels on my skin. The light citrus scent is lovely, and it's like getting a little mini facial to wind down my night. It's gentle on my skin and I've definitely noticed smoother skin since using it.

I used the Farmacy Bright On Daily Foam Exfoliator for a week and really enjoyed it. I used it daily and my skin felt clean smooth and brighter without feeling stripped or irritated. I love how gentle the foam is while still exfoliating and how fresh my skin looks after each use. One thing that could be improved is the scent since it is a little strong for sensitive skin. Overall it is super girl approved and a great addition to my routine

I'm using this product every single day in the morning and I noticed my skin is more soft, and is part of my routine now, I love it, I bought another for my mother in law cuz she love how my skin looks even when only use this product, I recommend it.

avis.titre: A must for my skincare routine!
avis.texte: I am obsessed with the Bright On Daily Foam Exfoliator by Farmacy! From the first use, it felt like the perfect balance between gentle and effective. Unlike other exfoliators I've tried that either feel too harsh or don't really do anything, this one gives my skin a fresh, smooth glow without irritation. I definitely notice a difference in my skin texture and dullness. I feel that my complexion looks brighter and more even! I will definitelt be getting it again a because I feel like it is a must for my skincare routine ! The only negative is I don't LOVE the smell but it's not bad. Thank you Farmacy for providing this product for free in exchange for a review.

avis.titre: A Must Have If You Suffer From Dullness!
avis.texte: After using this exfoliator for a few weeks I have noticed a dramatic difference in my skin. It is so much brighter now, all my dullness has disappeared. It really is a miracle product!

avis.titre: Get that facial glow in 30 seconds!
avis.texte: This product has become a fantastic addition to my skincare routine. It's incredibly easy to use, and I've already noticed a noticeable difference after just one use. My face looks radiant and hydrated, almost as if I've had a facial! I received this product to give my honest review.
This is so good. I was a little hesitant at first but this surpassed my expectations. I would definitely recommend this.

avis.titre: This exfoliater is a game changer!
avis.texte: This foam exfoliator works wonders. My skin started off dull. Upon using this, the application went so quickly that it was easy to incorporate in my daily routine. This comes out as a foam without much scent. You keep it on the skin for 30 seconds before rinsing. My skin didn't feel too tight which was nice. After a couple of weeks using this, my skin looks more even and a little brighter, which was nice considering I felt dull before. The foam was nice and gentle. There were no burning feelings which is nice in an exfoliator because sometimes they burn, but not this one. I'm happy to be using this product.

It smelled amazing! It might be overwhelming for some but I loved the smell. My skin feels and looks really good after just a couple weeks of use. It can be a little drying so I don't use it everyday but it is definitely part of my skincare routine. I like the foam pump as well. Even though I have been using it for a little over 2 weeks now, I could skin feeling softer and looking more even with less dark spots and a slight glow.

avis.titre: A must have in my routine
avis.texte: After using this product over the past few weeks, I am loving the results! It has helped keep my dry skin feeling hydrated. Application is easy, and the formula is perfect. Texture is foamy and applies well on your skin.

The Farmacy Bright On Daily AHA Foam Exfoliator is a total game-changer for a quick morning glow. I loved the airy foam texture; it feels super gentle on my skin and rinses away in just 30 seconds. The Mandelic Acid and Fermented Lemon Peel duo really smoothed out my rough patches without any of that typical post-exfoliation tightness. It has a fresh, light scent that makes the whole process feel like a mini facial. While it's slightly more of a splurge than a basic cleanser, the instant "baby-soft" finish and noticeable brightening make it worth every penny for my daily routine

avis.titre: Great addition to any skin care routine
avis.texte: I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. I have used the product for two weeks and have noticed smoother feeling skin. It is very gentle, causes no irritation. Has a great light smell and Light feeling on the skin. I will recommend this product to others.
Loved adding this to my skin care routine. I feel like it has helped brighten my skin- smells really good. Def add!

I love this exfoliator. I've been using this product for about a month.It's gentle, and isn't abrasive, but got rid of my strawberry legs, and leaves my skin so smooth, and bright. The foam formula is easy to apply. The scent is fresh with hints of citrus. I love this company and 10/10 recommend trying brightening foam exfoliator.

avis.titre: Really liked this product for my skim care routine
avis.texte: I really liked this product, it was easy to use and left my skin feeling super hydrated and moisturized but not a greasy type feeling. I will definitely be adding this to my regular skin care routine. It also smells very nice too.

This product is really nice. I like that it's a foaming cleanser and feels very gentle on my skin. The fragrance is light which is nice and not overpowering. It says it's an exfoliant, but I didn't feel like there was a harsh scrubbing factor. I didn't really notice my skin getting brighter, but that could be to postpartum hormones. Overall , it's a nice product.
Longtime user of Farmacy products and am loving this foam exfoliator. One pump gives a lush foam. So easy to apply and rinse off. Has a familiar scent of vitamin c products. Love.

avis.titre: it's a great option for oily skin
avis.texte: As someone with oily skin, I found the Farmacy Bright On Daily Foam Exfoliator to be a gentle yet effective cleanser that doesn't strip my skin. The light foaming texture feels fresh and helps remove excess oil without leaving my face tight or dry. After regular use, my skin looks clearer and smoother, especially around areas prone to congestion. It exfoliates mildly enough for daily use while still giving a noticeable brightening effect.

I've been using the Farmacy Bright On Daily AHA Exfoliating Foam for 15 days and have seen visible improvements in my skiiin. it looks brighter, smoother, and more refreshed. The cleanser feels gentle, doesn't dry out my skin, and provides mild exfoliation that makes my complexion look clearer and more even. Overall, it's a good product with noticeable results in a short time and works well for daily use.
Leaves skin soft and is very gentle considering that it exfoliates!

avis.titre: Great option for acid based exfoliating
avis.texte: First time trying both an acid exfoliator and this product specifically. It says it can be used daily but I used it a few times a week. I usually exfoliate the old school way, soap and a washcloth, but I was surprised to see just as good results using this product instead of my usual method. The increased cell turnover is real, after a couple days I can see the skin in my t zone begin to almost "flake" (that's probably not the right word to use but), and that's when I know it's time to use it again. My skin is normal, on the dry side in winter, and it doesn't cause my skin to feel drier or oily, net neutral response there. No irritation or sensitivity after using this product. The scent is very subtle.

This is the first item I have used from Farmacy and I love it. I have been using this face wash for a few weeks now and have seen a difference. The directions say to leave it on for 30 seconds before rinsing. After washing my face, I feel like my face looks clean and a little brighter. The difference isn't dramatic but it does give my skin a little pick me up. The smell is very subtle and smells like oranges. I definitely recommend trying this product especially if you struggle with dull skin like I do.

It's hard to find a good exfoliator for Florida climate with humidity and heat almost everyday. The foam is very gentle yet effective. It exfoliates without irritation, redness, or over-drying, which is hard to find if you're prone to breakouts, clogged pores, or sensitivity. My skin feels clean, smooth, and refreshed after every use, not tight or stripped.

I've been really enjoying the Farmacy Bright On Daily AHA Foam Exfoliator. The foaming texture feels light and refreshing, and it doesn't irritate my skin at all. It cleans well while still feeling gentle, and my face always feels smooth and soft after using it. With over a week use, my skin looks brighter and better tone. It's a great option if you want daily exfoliation without that tight or dry feeling. I would definitely keep this in my skincare routine.

This is one of those cleansers that actually makes a difference. The first time I used Bright On, my skin felt smoother immediately, like I'd just had a mini facial. It gently exfoliates without any sting or dryness, and over time my texture and dullness really started to fade. I love that I can use it every day and still keep my skin calm. It gives me that fresh, polished glow that makes me feel confident even before makeup.

This product was a little difficult to incorporate into my routine for some reason, but once I did I liked the effect. It helped my dull, winter skin look brighter and more even. I like the foaming effect, and I also like the citrus smell (I know some reviewers did not like it, but it "smells like it works." The amount of product you get is also decent.

I have combo skin with very stubborn dry patches on my forehead and around my nose, and this has been such a pleasant surprise. After just one week of daily use, my skin feels incredibly soft, smooth, and more even. It gently exfoliates without irritating or drying out my skin, and I love that it doesn't leave that tight, stripped feeling some exfoliators do. My dry patches look noticeably improved and my skin feels balanced and refreshed after every use. I've officially added this to my daily routine and would absolutely recommend it to anyone with combo skin or persistent dry texture looking for a gentle but effective exfoliant.

It is a very nice foaming face wash that I feel like really cleanses the skin. I did think after persistent use and especially with the winter weather, if not moisturized properly could feel drying to the skin. Also was a nice morning face wash when washing at the sink, but using in the shower could get your skin/hands wet which it says on the instructions to have them both dry. If they do get wet, it's just not as foaming which is my favorite part!
Absolutely loved this Pharmacy facial wash! It left my skin feeling clean, soft, and refreshed without drying it out. Definitely a new staple in my skincare routine.
I love this product so much it's now part of my daily skin care routine

avis.titre: A new staple in my routine!
avis.texte: I was given this item in exchange for my honest review. I've been using the Bright On Daily AHA Foam Exfoliator for a bit now, and I'm honestly impressed. It's gentle enough that I can use it regularly, but I still feel like it actually does something. My skin feels smoother right after, and over time I've noticed it looks brighter and more even. You do have to use it on a clean face and leave it on for about 30 seconds before rinsing, which I don't mind at all. It's quick and easy and still fits into my routine without feeling annoying or time consuming. I really like the foam texture. It's light, not gritty at all, and doesn't leave my face feeling tight or stripped. I have sensitive leaning skin, so I'm always nervous about exfoliants, but this one hasn't irritated me or caused any redness. One thing worth mentioning is the smell. It definitely has a chemical scent that they try to cover with a citrus smell, but the chemical smell still comes through at first. That said, it does fade pretty quickly once you start using it, so it's not a deal breaker for me. Overall, I've really been enjoying this product, and it's made me genuinely curious to try more from this brand. If the rest of their products work as well as this one has for me, I'd definitely be interested in adding more to my routine.

Love this exfoliator! Farmacy Bright On Daily Exfoliator is gentle enough for everyday use but still leaves my skin noticeably smoother and brighter. No irritation, no dryness—just a healthy glow. Perfect if you want results without harsh exfoliation

avis.titre: Bright On Daily AHA Foam Exfoliator – A Game Changer
avis.texte: Bright On Daily AHA Foam Exfoliator has quickly become a must-have in my skincare routine. From the very first use, my skin felt noticeably smoother, cleaner, and refreshed without any irritation or tightness. The lightweight foaming texture is luxurious and gentle, yet incredibly effective. It exfoliates just enough to remove dead skin cells and dull buildup while maintaining my skin's moisture barrier. Unlike harsh scrubs, this AHA formula delivers a brightening effect without over-drying or causing sensitivity. With consistent use, I've noticed a visible improvement in my skin's tone and texture. My complexion looks more radiant, pores appear refined, and my skin feels balanced and healthy. It's perfect for daily use and layers beautifully with the rest of my skincare products. If you're looking for an exfoliator that's gentle enough for everyday use but powerful enough to deliver real results, Bright On Daily AHA Foam Exfoliator is absolutely worth it. My skin has never looked this clear, smooth, and glowing.
I have been using this product for about a month now. I notice my skin has been a lot brighter and smoother. I think it does an excellent job gently exfoliating my skin.
I love this product. It gentle yet works well. It is now apart of my daily routine
This foam exfoliater works so well, especially on my chin. It does not tingle or irritate my skin. The foaming sensation is a nice aspect.

This is my ultimate new favorite night time cleanser! I love how clean my face feels without drying it out. I am in my older 30s so finding cost efficient products while not drying my ever aging skin out is really important to me and my pocketbook. I loved the way my skin was fresh and supple, feeling super refreshed but not tight like some other exfoliators do. I use this at night and follow it up with a moisturizer to keep everything locked in. I definitely recommend adding this to your cabinet for a refreshing cleanser that doesn't dry or make your skin flakey!

I have used this product daily since receiving it, and i really do enjoy it! I have really rough dry skin, and I definitely could see a difference in my skin! I also have sensitive skin and did not have any issues. It did not leave any residue on my skin afterwards. "Farmacy sent me this free sample through the BzzAgent sampling program."

I really love this daily exfoliator. The foam is very soft and gentle, but it leaves my skin noticeably smoother and brighter. It cleans well without drying and gives my face a fresh, healthy glow. My skin feels very clean, soft, and comfortable after every use. One of my favorite steps in my skincare routine.

I received this item for review and honestly, I love it. The scent is not too overpowering. It had a pleasant citrus scent that is quite light. I tested it on my hand and after washing away the cleanser only a faint scent remained. As for skin-feel. After washing the cleanser off my face it did feel a bit sticky but the feeling did dissipate over time. After a while, my skin felt quite soft and hydrated. I like that it doesn't feel heavy on the skin and feels quite clean after use. I would purchase it again!
I used this product once a week since i have very dry skin and it has made my skin feel less dry and very smooth
This exfoliator is awesome. It's gentle but efficient. I was looking for something that will soften my skin without destroying my skin. This was perfect! I'd definitely recommend it!

I received this product free in exchange of my honest review. I have dry skin and usually avoid exfoliating my face, even though I have dead skin cells that piles up around my chin. this Farmacy Bright On Daily Foam Exfoliator is very gentle and effective. It is gentle, non drying and easy to use. It is exfoliator but can be use as cleanser. So you put on face , leave on face for 30 seconds and rinse. It gives you a brighter skin without stripping it out from its natural oils. The farmacy use clean ingredients which are very good for a non irritating gentle exfoliating experience. I recommend this product.
